problem: The candidate binds quantity units to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/MilliM and http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/M, but the canonical QUDT unit IRIs are http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MilliM and http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M. Canonical quantity values therefore fail the unit constraints, and the SPARQL table and threshold checks use the wrong unit IRIs.
required_change: Declare a QUDT unit prefix for http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/ and replace qudt:MilliM and qudt:M in sh:hasValue constraints and SPARQL unit comparisons with the corresponding vocabulary-unit IRIs.
regression_guard: Preserve canonical QUDT vocabulary-unit IRIs for millimetres and metres in both SHACL unit constraints and executable calculations.
